hazardMeta.caveat: Hazard grades are compiled by the author from the published sources listed against each district. Grades are assigned at province level except where a source names the district directly (DMH Wipha warning, July 2025). LESMIS itself carries no hazard field on the school record — only two of 676 flagged building records name flood as a cause.

ethnoMeta.caveat: Ethno-linguistic classification follows the four families used in Lao official statistics (Lao-Tai, Mon-Khmer, Hmong-Iu Mien, Chinese-Tibetan). Assignments are the author’s compilation of province-level ethnographic geography and are shown at province granularity with a confidence grade. They are NOT a school attribute: LESMIS carries no ethnicity, home-language or language-of-instruction field on the school record. Treat this layer as context for the language in which a warning would have to be understood, not as data about any individual school.

enrolment.note: The extract holds no student counts at school or district level. LESMIS does track enrolment through the Student Life Cycle module, but it was not part of the 28 August 2026 extraction. These are the published national lower- and upper-secondary series cited in the proposal.
enrolment.levelSource: School counts by level are real LESMIS/SBA figures, available at province level only (SBA Province sheet).
